## About
Tatkal Claims is India's most trusted insurance dispute resolution platform. We help policyholders recover rightful claims through expert legal professionals. 500+ cases assisted, ₹20+ Crores recovered.

## Services
- Claim Rejection Appeals
- Claim Delay Resolution
- Health Insurance Disputes
- Motor Insurance Claims
- Mis-selling Complaints
- Short Settlement Issues
